notes: The runtime is the browser itself: open the page in Atlas (browser_navigate to a local file server or deployed URL) and verify with a screenshot. No build step is needed for plain HTML/CSS.

run.command: open the page in Atlas: browser_navigate to http://localhost:<port>/ (serve with: npx serve . or python3 -m http.server)

runtime.install: a browser (Atlas / Chromium) + a static file server
runtime.name: Browser (Chromium via Atlas)

test.command: visual check with browser_screenshot + html-validate; no unit-test runner for plain HTML/CSS
